factual_review.note: ThePrint/PTI confirms the crash occurred Tuesday 3 Nov between 8–9 pm; report was published 4 Nov. Two deaths and the basic collision facts are corroborated. Conflicting reports differ on motorcycles/injuries; script correctly omits disputed details and does not claim an arrest.

HT, TOI and Statesman report 1,133 inspections, 935 samples, about 54 quintals seized, estimated value ₹1.32 crore and 27 licence suspensions. Keep inspection/seizure/licence action distinct from lab-confirmed adulteration. Muzaffarnagar 220 kg sweets item is supported by Jagran and TOI; generic wording is appropriate.
TOI and Moneycontrol corroborate 20 additional Namo Bharat trips from 4 Nov. Script correctly says extra trips, not 20 new trains; live timings are not stated.

Three reports describe CAQM's 30 Oct direction for up to 50% physical office attendance and dust-generating construction curbs, 5–20 Nov, including Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar. Direct CAQM order PDF was not retrieved; retain attribution and exact exemptions.
September CPI values are supported by official PIB/MoSPI data; weak soil moisture, rabi sowing and price risks are attributed to Reuters and presented as outlook, not guaranteed local price rises.
Reuters reports the 15–17% ethanol blending possibility as an industry estimate due to feedstock constraints; script correctly does not call it a final government target or say E20 was scrapped.

Reuters court-filing report and earlier Delhi High Court order coverage support the labelling dispute and old-stock/new-manufacture distinction. It is not a toxicity finding or final ruling; no outcome of the 5 Nov hearing is claimed.

Official CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0058 dated 4 Nov and Reuters corroborate the AI-assisted campaign against BFSI entities. Script correctly says the warning is directed at institutions and does not imply every customer account is compromised.

PTI/ThePrint, Indian Express and other reports of the Supreme Court directions support certified green crackers only on 7–8 Nov in stated windows, 300 m no-cracker zones and full ban from 9 Nov. Keep Delhi-NCR scope explicit.
IMD subdivision warning page issued 5 Nov shows no warning for West Uttar Pradesh 5–11 Nov. City temperature figures from older 3 Nov pages are not presented as fresh current observations.
